limits: The sixteen new optimizer runs are the statistical units. Positions, duplicate molecules and ten checkpoints are not independent repetitions.
Old development optimizer runs are excluded from all new primary run-level inference.
Released Chemprop checkpoints and optimized RF share the broad ExCAPE source; incomplete original training composition prevents a claim of independent biological validation.
Native-route audit is inherited from saved method records and independently rechecked after scientific execution.
Alerts and low properties remain in the primary denominator. Secondary contrasts are exploratory; no positive secondary replaces the sole primary.
Technical unknowns retain identifiable paired bounds. Source fallback properties do not become known final-policy properties.

external_vector_arithmetic.arithmetic: Unrounded arithmetic mean of the ten saved task-column probabilities.

evaluation_design.statistics: 16 independent optimizer runs, 8 per fixed task, paired within-run raw yields; task-equal mean primary, Welch-Satterthwaite 95% interval/test; prespecified within-task run bootstrap100000 seed2026101801 sensitivity. Secondary contrasts exploratory, no molecular pseudoreplication; technical unknown bounds retained.
evaluation_design.AiZ_fold_reuse_note: AiZ fixed-arm structures used the completed formal512 two-task ten-fold cache. Task-only inputs are not imported as incomplete two-task vectors.

historical_predictions.merge_note: Every cache is validated by the original reader. Earlier provenance is retained for compatible vectors. Required fixed-output vectors still reject differences above 1e-7; conflicts for structures absent from the fixed required set are recorded and excluded from evaluation. No score-based selection or relaxed tolerance.

physical_new_inference_cumulative.scope: New missing-only checkpoint/structure work in this output directory. Batch time excludes model loading, descriptors and historical work.
